$comment: Single source of truth for the forbidden code-comment patterns. Consumed by tests/code-comment-rules.test.ts and scripts/hooks/commit-sweep-guard.sh. Regex dialect is the intersection of JavaScript, Perl and Rust-free PCRE: \b, \d, \w, (?:), (?=), (?!), (?<!). Rationale for the epic shape is in scripts/hooks/README.md.
